svg.title: Very early version — experienced makers only
svg.desc: Robbi is far from perfect and provided as-is. Expect tinkering, fixes and several hours of work. Design and components will change. Backward compatibility is not guaranteed. The current printed enclosure iteration has not been physically tested: CAD and reference slicer checks only. Dry-fit printed parts and actual components before powered use.

g.text: VERY EARLY VERSION · EXPERIENCED MAKERS ONLY
Robbi is far from perfect. Expect tinkering, fixes and several hours of work.
The design, components and software will change.
Backward compatibility is not guaranteed. Provided as-is.
Build it if you are comfortable troubleshooting and adapting the project.
PRINTED ENCLOSURE · THIS ITERATION HAS NOT BEEN PHYSICALLY TESTED
CAD and reference slicer checks only. Dry-fit parts and components before powered use.
